name: MeitY SAMRIDH Scheme
summary: Startup accelerator programme for software product startups, providing investment alongside structured acceleration through selected accelerators. Funding is matched against investment the startup raises itself.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
implementing_agency: MeitY Startup Hub and selected accelerators
benefit_description: Investment of up to Rs 40 lakh per startup through the selected accelerator, based on evaluation and matched against investment raised by the startup.

criteria.description: The startup must be incorporated in India.
The startup must have a working product, not only an idea. SAMRIDH accelerates existing products rather than funding concept validation.
The startup should have a software product with demonstrated customer traction and a credible path to scaling.
The startup must be able to bring matching investment, since the scheme co-invests rather than funding alone.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Prepared in-house. Accelerators screen primarily on traction, so revenue, retention and pipeline numbers carry the deck.
Already issued at incorporation; download from the MCA portal if needed.
From your auditor. Provisional statements are usually accepted where a financial year is incomplete.

windows.notes: Intake happens through cohort calls run by individual accelerators rather than a single central window, so the accelerator's calendar is the one to track.

benefits.description: Investment of up to Rs 40 lakh routed through the accelerator, plus structured mentoring and customer connections.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Not a grant. Provided as investment, so it involves dilution or a convertible instrument. Matched against investment the startup raises.
